name: @ledger/api
description: HTTP API and persistence. The only place in the tool that reads the environment or touches the database.

scripts.// dev: Builds first. This package imports @ledger/contract through its package exports, which resolve to dist/ and not src/, so in a fresh checkout or worktree, where no dist exists yet, the server dies on start with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (lg-12); a dist left behind by an older branch is worse, starting the server against a stale contract. tsc --build walks this package's project references, so one command covers core, contract and books. Two boundaries worth knowing: it runs once, so node --watch restarting this process does not rebuild a contract edited mid-session; and it cannot restore a dist deleted by hand, because tsc --build reads its own tsconfig.tsbuildinfo and the source hashes, never the emitted .js. Run npm run clean first for that. The downloader's api carries the same script, from #151.
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --watch --import tsx src/main.ts
